source_summary: Winter Chinese landscape with pale layered mountains above a river valley, leafless groves, a small village compound, open water with sandbars, a tiny moored boat, and foreground marsh banks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper/silk texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: left_snow_mountain_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the large pale mountain mass occupying the upper-left and center-left, including the rounded summit, adjoining left shoulder peaks, soft snow-like silhouettes, and faint tonal wash transitions.
must_preserve: faint inner slope transitions without added texture

motifs.name: central_rounded_hill_ridges
motifs.description: Isolate the middle stacked rounded hills below the main mountain, with overlapping arched ridge forms and dark dotted contour strokes along several crests.
must_preserve: pale wash shadows between hill layers
soft descending slopes fading into mist
delicate separation lines between overlapping hills

motifs.name: right_mist_peaks_basin
motifs.description: Isolate the receding right-side peak group and misty basin: pale angular peaks, a darker low valley hollow, and horizontal haze bands leading toward the water.
must_preserve: gray-brown wash pool in the valley
small dark dotted ridge marks on the nearer slope

motifs.name: midground_winter_village_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense midground cluster of leafless winter trees sheltering a small village compound, including trunks, tangled branches, roofs, fences, shrubs, and the snowy ground plane immediately around them.
must_preserve: dark textured tree trunks with broken brush edges
small roof geometry partly hidden by branches
stippling around shrubs and bank edges
pale winter ground washes between trunks

motifs.name: right_riverside_willow_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the right-bank leaning tree and small boat scene: the arched bare tree over the water, the narrow bank, the tiny boat with vertical post or mast, and adjacent rippled water edge.
must_preserve: leaning trunk curve and exposed roots
thin bare branch network reaching over water
single vertical post or mast on the boat
subtle water wash around the boat

motifs.name: open_river_sandbars
motifs.description: Isolate the broad open river surface with pale horizontal water bands, sandbars, distant low banks, and small scattered dark marks in the open water.
must_preserve: soft misty transitions between water and shore

motifs.name: foreground_bare_tree_clump
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground clump of leafless trees rising from a low bank, with multiple textured trunks, forked branches, small shrubs, exposed roots, and nearby snowy shoreline contours.
must_preserve: stippling along the mound and shrub masses

motifs.name: lower_right_marsh_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the low lower-right marsh and distant bank details, including small hut-like roof forms, low rocks or mounds, reeds, tiny waterfowl-like dots, and faint shoreline strokes.
must_preserve: tiny dark dot accents across the water
pale layered washes of shallow water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
